def transform(grid):
    # Copy the first non-divider panel into every compartment.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i])) == 1 and grid[i][0] != bg]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [w]
    ra, rz = rb[0] + 1, rb[1]
    ca, cz = cb[0] + 1, cb[1]
    source = [grid[r][ca:cz] for r in range(ra, rz)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        a, b = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            x, y = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            if a == ra and x == ca:
                continue
            for dr in range(b-a):
                for dc in range(y-x):
                    out[a+dr][x+dc] = source[dr][dc]

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # Identify divider lines, then tile the most populated panel into all panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i])) == 1 and grid[i][0] != bg]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rows + [h], [-1] + cols + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        a, b = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            x, y = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            panel = [row[x:y] for row in grid[a:b]]
            score = sum(v != bg for row in panel for v in row)
            panels.append((score, a, b, x, y, panel))
    _, sa, sb, sx, sy, source = max(panels, key=lambda q:q[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for _, a, b, x, y, _ in panels:
        if (a, b, x, y) == (sa, sb, sx, sy):
            continue
        for dr in range(b-a):
            for dc in range(y-x):
                out[a+dr][x+dc] = source[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
